final: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS matched_order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(matched_order_count) AS value FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.matched_order_count) AS average_count_above_overall_average, AVG(c.matched_order_count - a.value) AS average_excess_above_overall_average FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN avg_count AS a WHERE c.matched_order_count > a.value
